name_zh: 资源联邦主义/北极治理先驱：资源联邦主义与西北航道主权
name_en: Resource Federalism/Arctic Governance Pioneers: Resource Federalism & Northwest Passage Sovereignty
description_zh: 加拿大资源联邦主义由三代建构者跨越百年共进：克里福德·西夫顿 (1861-1929) 劳里埃政府内阁部长，推动西部拓荒/移民/资源开发，奠定"资源联邦"经济基础；皮埃尔·特鲁多 (1919-2000) 1980 国家能源规划 (NEP) 试图联邦控制石油收益，虽失败但确立联邦能源管辖权；斯蒂芬·哈珀 (1959-) 推动北极主权军事化 (纳努维克基地/北极巡逻舰/北极演习)、西北航道内水主张、资源开发审批加速。三人跨自由/保守党，共同体现 M175 资源联邦主义——以"省有资源/联邦管辖/收益均等化/北极主权"四支柱，在联邦制框架内平衡资源民族主义与国家统一。
description_en: Canadian resource federalism built by three generations: Clifford Sifton (1861-1929) Laurier cabinet minister drove western settlement/immigration/resource development, laying 'resource federation' economic base; Pierre Trudeau (1919-2000) 1980 National Energy Program (NEP) attempted federal control of oil revenues, failed but entrenched federal energy jurisdiction; Stephen Harper (1959-) advanced Arctic sovereignty militarization (Nanisivik base/Arctic patrol ships/Arctic exercises), Northwest Passage internal waters claim, resource development fast-tracking. Across Liberal/Conservative, all three exemplify M175 Resource Federalism—four pillars of 'provincial resource ownership + federal jurisdiction + revenue equalization + Arctic sovereignty' balancing resource nationalism & national unity within federal framework.
reason_zh: 加拿大资源治理独特在于"省有资源(宪法 92A)+联邦管辖(贸易/环境/原住民)+均等化支付(宪法 36)+北极主权"四重锚定。西夫顿开发西部，特鲁多争联邦权，哈珀守北极主权。M175 区隔于 M39 鸟笼经济(通用)、M174 多元文化联邦(社会)、M176 北极治理(国际法)，核心在于"联邦制内的资源主权平衡+北极地缘战略"。
reason_en: Canadian resource governance unique in four anchors: 'provincial resource ownership (s.92A) + federal jurisdiction (trade/environment/indigenous) + equalization (s.36) + Arctic sovereignty'. Sifton opened West, Trudeau fought for federal power, Harper defended Arctic sovereignty. M175 distinct from M39 Birdcage Economy (general), M174 Multicultural Federation (social), M176 Arctic Governance (international law), core: 'resource sovereignty balance within federalism + Arctic geostrategy'.
steps_zh: 西部资源开发奠基：西夫顿 1896-1905 移民政策/铁路土地赠与/西部小麦经济，确立资源出口导向
国家能源规划冲突：1980 NEP 联邦税/价格控制/石油自给，阿省强烈反对，1985 取消但确立联邦能源权
均等化支付宪法化：1982 宪法 s.36 承诺"合理可比水平"公共服务，资源富省转移支付资源穷省
北极主权军事化：哈珀 2006-2015 纳努维克深水港/北极巡逻舰/年度北极演习/西北航道内水主张
原住民资源共治：影响评估法/自由事先知情同意 (FPIC)/现代条约资源收益分享，联邦制内共治
steps_en: Western resource development foundation: Sifton 1896-1905 immigration policy/railway land grants/wheat economy, establishing resource export orientation
National Energy Program conflict: 1980 NEP federal tax/price controls/oil self-sufficiency, Alberta fierce opposition, 1985 cancelled but federal energy jurisdiction entrenched
Equalization constitutionalization: 1982 Constitution s.36 commits to 'reasonably comparable' public services, resource-rich provinces transfer to resource-poor
Arctic sovereignty militarization: Harper 2006-2015 Nanisivik deepwater port/Arctic patrol ships/annual Arctic exercises/Northwest Passage internal waters claim
Indigenous resource co-governance: Impact Assessment Act/FPIC/modern treaty revenue sharing, co-governance within federalism
expected_zh: 以"省有资源+联邦管辖+均等化+北极主权"四重锚定，实现资源富省/资源穷省/北极原住民三方利益平衡，资源联邦主义指数全球领先。
expected_en: Four anchors of 'provincial resources + federal jurisdiction + equalization + Arctic sovereignty' achieve balance among resource-rich/provinces, resource-poor provinces, Arctic indigenous peoples, resource federalism index globally leading.
case_zh: 阿尔伯塔油砂/萨省钾肥/纽芬兰海上油田/北极矿产，省有联邦管；均等化支付 2023 $240 亿；北极演习 Operation NANOOK 年度化；西北航道争端美加管控。
case_en: AB oil sands/SK potash/NL offshore oil/Arctic minerals, provincial ownership federal jurisdiction; equalization 2023 $24B; Operation NANOOK annualized; Northwest Passage dispute US-Canada managed.
cross_cultural_impact: Resource federalism model for federations; Arctic sovereignty law; equalization payment design

diaspora_influence: Resource sector global talent; Canadian mining diaspora worldwide
